title: Translation invariance of the affine-space trace over a Noetherian base
statement:
Let $N\geq1$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme on which $N$ is invertible, where Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $d\geq0$, put $V=\mathbf A^d_S$ with projection $q:V\to S$ [def-sbc-affine-space], and work in the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with the ordinary finite Tate sheaves $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A_T$, their twists and pullback identifications [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Put $L=A_V(d)[2d]$ and let $t_q:Rq_!L\to A_S$ be the explicit coordinate-tower counit trace of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], with ordinary etale compact supports [def-amb-etale-compact-support].

For a section $a:S\to\mathbf A^d_S$ of $q$, that is $a=(a_1,\dots,a_d)\in\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)^d$, let $\tau_a:V\to V$ be the $S$-automorphism $z\mapsto z-a$. For the Cartesian square with both vertical maps $q$, bottom map $1_S$ and top map $\tau_a$, let $\operatorname{Ex}_{\tau_a}:Rq_!L\to Rq_!\tau_a^*L$ be the compact-support exchange of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], and let $\kappa_a:\tau_a^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}L$ be the Tate pullback identification. Then $$t_q\circ Rq_!(\kappa_a)\circ\operatorname{Ex}_{\tau_a}=t_q.$$ The case $d=0$ is included, where $\tau_a$ is the identity.

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-universal-translation-multiplier. For its locally constant units-valued multiplier b on the coordinate tower, pull the underlying A-valued locally constant function along the inverse of affineTraceAffineSpaceIso. The zero-section clause and lem-pur-affine-constant-section-zero-detection show its value is 1 everywhere. Cancel the scheme isomorphism and use injectivity of A-units into A to obtain b(x)=1 on the tower. This includes empty bases, dimension zero and the zero coefficient ring.

Construct v:S→affineTraceTower S d as homOfVector(id,a) followed by affineTraceAffineSpaceIso.inv. Applying the inverse/hom equation of the coordinate isomorphism to each polynomial coordinate proves v.appTop(affineTraceCoordinate i)=a_i. The base-change clause of lem-pur-universal-translation-multiplier supplies a witness wT whose action and trace are exactly the published translation action at these coordinates and the published counit. Its scalar_spec is multiplication by b composed with v, hence multiplication by 1. The sheafification universal property shows this scalar map is the identity: its composite with every constant generator sends c to 1*c=c. Functoriality gives that the derived scalar map is identity.

The witness conjugation equation is trace.inv ≫ action ≫ trace.hom = identity. Cancel trace.inv, rewrite the witness equations action_eq and trace_hom, and replace the pulled-back coordinate vector by a. Associativity gives precisely the required equality. The base-change witness already states the equality for the explicit exchange and Tate maps, so no extra compact-support or coefficient coherence theorem is needed in this assembly.
